info.title: Tomba
info.description: Tomba finds, verifies, and enriches professional email addresses, phone numbers, and company data. Search a domain for contacts, find a person's email address, check that an address can receive mail, and look up company profiles and technologies.

get.description: Finds the email addresses Tomba has for a company, by domain or company name. Send a domain or a company name.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Company domain, such as stripe.com. Send domain or company.

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Company name, such as Stripe. When Tomba knows the company, its domain is searched, even if you also send domain. An unknown company fails with 422 unless you also send domain.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. On the Free plan outside a workspace, every request returns page 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of addresses per page. On the Free plan outside a workspace, a value above 10 fails with 400.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), such as US, to return only people in that country. GET /location lists the countries that have addresses.

parameters.name: department
parameters.description: Return only people in these departments. Separate several with commas, such as engineering,sales. Values: accounting, administrative, communication, diversity, education, engineering, executive, facilities, finance, healthcare, hr, it, legal, management, marketing, operations, pr, sales, security, software, support, warehouse. Unknown values are ignored.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: personal returns only addresses that belong to one person, generic only role addresses such as support@.

parameters.name: enrich_mobile
parameters.description: Set to true to also get each person's phone numbers in phone_data. Phone numbers cost extra credits.

parameters.name: webhook_url
parameters.description: Optional URL that also receives the result in a POST request when the result qualifies. The response body is returned either way.

400.description: Bad request. The credentials are missing, malformed, or expired, or a parameter or plan rule rejected the request. The type field identifies the exact cause.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Searches Tomba's company database with a text query, structured filters, or both.

schema.description: Send query or filters. When you send query, Tomba generates filters from it and ignores any filters you send; the generated filters are returned in meta.filters.

query.description: Natural-language description of the companies you want, 8 to 100 characters. Filters are generated from it on every request, so use it for the first request and send the returned meta.filters as filters for the next pages.

filters.description: Structured filters for company search. Every filter is optional, and a company must match all the filters you send. Most values are matched against Tomba's company data, which isn't normalized to a fixed list; size, founded, and revenue accept only the values listed for them and ignore any other value. Older size labels, such as 51-200 or 10001+, still work and match the nearest range.
